import novamind_api as nm

def q(sql):
    return nm.query(sql)['rows']

print('=== 1. DAILY USAGE d211-217 ===')
for r in q("SELECT day, SUM(usage_units) u, COUNT(*) n FROM daily_usage WHERE day BETWEEN 211 AND 217 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day"):
    print(r['day'], f"{r['u']:,}", 'users', r['n'])

print('=== 2. AD CHANNEL LEADS by week ===')
for r in q("SELECT CASE WHEN day BETWEEN 204 AND 210 THEN 'wk30' ELSE 'wk31' END wk, channel_id, group_id, SUM(leads_generated) leads, SUM(spend) spend FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day BETWEEN 204 AND 217 GROUP BY wk, channel_id, group_id ORDER BY wk, channel_id"):
    print(r['wk'], r['channel_id'], r['group_id'], 'leads', r['leads'], 'spend', round(r['spend']))

print('=== 3. CONV BY SOURCE (S1) wk30 vs wk31 ===')
for r in q("""SELECT CASE WHEN created_day BETWEEN 204 AND 210 THEN 'wk30' ELSE 'wk31' END wk,
  CASE WHEN acquisition_source='word_of_mouth' THEN 'wom' ELSE 'ads' END src,
  COUNT(*) leads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM subscriptions) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) subbed
  FROM customers WHERE created_day BETWEEN 204 AND 217 AND group_id='S1' GROUP BY wk, src"""):
    print(r['wk'], r['src'], 'leads', r['leads'], 'subbed', r['subbed'], 'conv', round(100*r['subbed']/r['leads'],1))

print('=== 3b. CONV BY GROUP wk31 ===')
for r in q("""SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) leads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM subscriptions) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) subbed
  FROM customers WHERE created_day BETWEEN 211 AND 217 GROUP BY group_id"""):
    print(r['group_id'], 'leads', r['leads'], 'subbed', r['subbed'], 'conv', round(100*r['subbed']/max(1,r['leads']),1))

print('=== 4. FRESH SUBS wk31: plan mix ===')
for r in q("SELECT plan, listed_price, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN 211 AND 217 GROUP BY plan, listed_price"):
    print(r['plan'], r['listed_price'], r['n'])

print('=== 5. r1 COHORTS (start 181-187, renewal due this week) ===')
for r in q("""SELECT plan, listed_price, COUNT(*) cohort,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) alive
  FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN 181 AND 187 GROUP BY plan, listed_price"""):
    print(r['plan'], r['listed_price'], 'cohort', r['cohort'], 'alive', r['alive'], 'exit%', round(100*(1-r['alive']/r['cohort']),1))

print('=== 6. MATURE (k>=2) dues this week & exits ===')
